name: Oxlint Static Code Analysis
note: oxlint prints one line per finding and no summary, so there is no sentence that means "passed". It also has no case structure, which is the only reason judging by exit code is safe here — see isGreen() in the runner.

mutations.name: source that does not parse
mutations.why: A build can still succeed from a stale bundle while the source in the tree is broken. The linter is the first thing that should notice.
